data.gender_notes: Nashema is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Nashama', meaning 'to breathe in', Nashema symbolizes the gentle and tender aspects of life. In Islamic culture, it is a name given to girls, symbolizing the delicate nature of a new life and the tender care of a mother. The name Nashema carries the meaning “Delicate, tender, gentle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nashema usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, tender, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nashema total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
